# Typefully

Typefully is a platform for creating and managing AI-powered content

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/typefully/.

## Actions

- **Create Draft**: Creates a draft in typefully.
- **Get Notifications** (read-only): Get notifications from typefully.
- **Get Recently Published** (read-only): Get recently published drafts from typefully.
- **Get Recently Scheduled Drafts** (read-only): Get recently scheduled drafts from typefully.
- **Mark Notifications Read**: Mark notifications as read in typefully.
